name: Crazy Cars - Bonus Challenge 1
author: JakeMailes
description:
I have done the four steps: (buggy as they may be)

- there is stacks and pyramids of boxes
- there are (more than) two on-coming crazy cars 
- you can change the camera with space/left shift/left alt (single player only 
   for now, I hope)
- you have two screen multiplayer

I have also attempted these extra's:

- there is a functional menu
- there is different background music for menu and gameplay 
- there is respawn points for player's and enemies (still very buggy)
- there is option to return to menu from gameplay                                                                     
I hope to fix the bugs as I get better at coding :D
